title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Customer Terms: Decision Period Courtesy on Declined Estimates
content:
**Courtesy clause.** The decision period earns a courtesy on Repair Estimates & Appointments storage goodwill: when the owner's decline request was confirmed **3** or more calendar days after it was requested the courtesy is **30.00 USD**; when it was confirmed at least one but fewer than **3** calendar days after it was requested the courtesy is **15.00 USD**; and when it was confirmed on the day it was requested, or no decline request is confirmed, there is no courtesy. The courtesy is added to the goodwill figure.

The decision period is read from the booking's decline request: the day it was requested and the date the customer confirmed it.

| Calendar days from request to confirmation | Courtesy |
|---|---|
| 0 (confirmed the same day) | none |
| 1 | 15.00 USD |
| 2 | 15.00 USD |
| 3 | 30.00 USD |
| 4 or more | 30.00 USD |
| No confirmed decline request | none |

Hypothetical dates: a decline request made on 3 June and confirmed on 5 June is 2 days — 15.00 USD; confirmed on 6 June, 3 days — 30.00 USD; confirmed on 3 June — no courtesy. A decline request still pending the customer's confirmation earns no courtesy.
